query:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.id = $3) AS "this!",
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE i.id <> $3 AND p.enabled) AS "others!"
           FROM identities i
           JOIN identity_providers p ON p.org_id = i.org_id AND p.id = i.provider_id
           WHERE i.org_id = $1 AND i.user_id = $2
